notes.title: Collection Update 0.95
notes.notes: [p]Hi everyone![/p][p]In this update, we've added a new Collection feature that allows you to review the details of cards and relics you've encountered in the game. Since older save files didn’t store collection data, players will still need to reveal encountered items as they play, sorry for the inconvenience![/p][p]We've also been working on new content and features based on your feedback. Stay tuned for future updates![/p][p][/p][p][b]Here is the full changelog:[/b][/p][p] [/p][h3]New Features[/h3][list][*][p]Added new Collection feature for cards and relics⭐[/p][/*][*][p]You can now play cards using number row on the keyboard[/p][/*][*][p]Camera movement can now be controlled by dragging with the right mouse button[/p][/*][*][p]Added an animation effect to highlight card cost changes in the hand[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Balance Adjustments[/h3][list][*][p]Adjusted the way card costs are modified by some relics and spell cards to better match expectations[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the strength of early enemies in Act II and Act III to smooth out difficulty spikes[/p][/*][*][p]Lowered the base HP of buildings, but now buildings gain HP when upgraded, making upgrade-focused strategies more viable[/p][list][*][p]Small buildings gain 100 HP per upgrade, large buildings gain 200 HP[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Improved the survivability of the Goddess Statue:[/p][list][*][p]Goddess Statue HP: 500 → 1000[/p][/*][*][p]Plating (the Goddess Statue’s self-protection skill) now provides a fixed 1000 shield each time it triggers[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Hatch[/b], [b]Clairvoyance[/b], and [b]Lightning Shield [/b]now have larger area[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the range indicators for [b]Rebirth Totem[/b] and [b]Watch Totem[/b] didn’t match their actual effect range[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the shop icon at the top of the screen disappeared before the end of a turn[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the banner image was not correctly displaying for different goddesses on the game result screen[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Balance Update 0.92
notes.notes: [p]Hi everyone![/p][p]A huge thank you to all players who supported Aurora Defense at launch! We deeply appreciate your invaluable feedback and suggestions.[/p][p]We’ve heard your concerns about balance and gameplay experience. In this update, we’ve fixed and optimized some of the more obvious issues. We’re also actively considering bigger system changes to enhance the fun and lay the groundwork for future content updates.[/p][p]Here is what's changed:[/p][h2]New Features[/h2][list][*][p]You can now use the [b]Inspect Field[/b] function (bottom-left corner) while receiving battle rewards or choosing building upgrades. This lets you check your current base and upgrade status to help make smarter decisions.[/p][/*][*][p]Building cards now show an icon indicating how many tiles it occupies.[/p][/*][*][p]Before dismantling a building, the tooltip will now show how many Crystals will be refunded.[/p][/*][*][p]A title is now displayed at the start of each Act.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Optimizations and Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]When buildings and units overlap, selecting will now prioritize the building.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where [b]Mirror Crystal[/b] could summon from destroyed summoning buildings.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where players could sometimes receive extra [b]Magic Crystal[/b] cards at the start of a turn.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed missing Crystal income prediction on the final turn of an Act.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved descriptions for some cards and relics.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Balance Adjustments[/h2][h3]General[/h3][list][*][p]Adjusted the starting decks for all Goddesses to better focus on their faction identities.[/p][/*][*][p]Buffed the [b]Plating[/b] ability on the [b]Goddess Statue[/b] (its self-protection skill).[/p][/*][*][p]Starting Crystals reduced from 6 to 5, but the Goddess level upgrades now affect turn 1 Crystal.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the movement speed bonus from upgrades.[/p][/*][*][p]Smoothed out the difficulty curve to improve pacing across a run.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Earth Faction[/h3][p][i]Tortoise was too strong in the current version, making the game less challenging. We’ve reduced its HP to lower its durability while increasing its base damage to keep it relevant in combat.[/i][/p][list][*][p][b]Tortoise[/b] HP: 400 → 300[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tortoise[/b] ATK: 20 → 5%[/p][/*][*][p][b]Moonstone[/b] upgrade effect: 10% → 5%[/p][/*][*][p][b]Mirror Crystal[/b] summon interval: 12 → 20[/p][/*][/list][h3]Fire Faction[/h3][p][i]We’ve increased the number of fire units on the battlefield and boosted the Phoenix’s attack power.[/i][/p][list][*][p][b]Firebird Nest[/b] summon time: 5 → 4.5[/p][/*][*][p][b]Firefeather Stand[/b] summon time: 7.5 → notes.title: Aurora Defense is Out Now!
notes.notes: [p]Aurora Defense has officially launched into Steam Early Access! To celebrate, we're offering a [b]25% launch discount[/b] for the first two weeks—don't miss it![/p][p][/p][p]We're super excited to finally share the game with you. As we continue developing, your feedback is absolutely crucial, so please let us know your thoughts in the discussions or a quick review. Every bit helps us shape Aurora Defense into its best form.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you so much for being here from the start. Let’s defend the light together![/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Aurora Defense - What’s Coming Next
notes.notes: [p]Hi everyone,[/p][p]With Aurora Defense entering Early Access tomorrow, we want to take a moment to share our development plans and what to expect going forward.[/p][p][/p][h2]Why Early Access[/h2][p]We started working on the idea for Aurora Defense about a year ago. The game combines roguelike deckbuilding with base-building tower defense. There are still many ideas we want to try, and joining Early Access gives us more time to develop the game further.[/p][p]It also gives us a chance to work with the community and helps us focus on the right things to do and make the game more fun to play.[/p][p][/p][h2]Current Focus[/h2][p]We are already receiving invaluable feedback from early playtests! And clearly our top priority for the moment is to improve the overall player experience and build a solid foundation for future updates, which includes:[/p][list][*][p]Improve game readability and add quality-of-life features to help you make better and informed build decisions.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix UI issues and polish translation.[/p][/*][*][p]Add a basic tutorial for new players.[/p][/*][*][p]Continue to optimize the game to make even larger-scale, epic battles possible.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]What's Next[/h2][p]Once we've done the quick fix , we plan to work on two types of updates:[/p][h3]Content Updates[/h3][p]Adding new cards, relics, units, and buildings to create more build variety and interesting synergies.[/p][h3]Feature Updates[/h3][p]Implementing new mechanics to add more depth to the game. Some of the things we’re currently exploring are:[/p][list][*][p]Improved defense range mechanics that let units better execute your strategy.[/p][/*][*][p]A new building grid system that allows mixing towers and summoners in a more flexible way.[/p][/*][*][p]New game modes, like Endless Mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Some sort of procedural generated timeline that gives more choices for build chances.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thanks for being part of our journey to 1.0, if you have questions or ideas, please let us know in the comments![/p][p]See you at launch.[/p]

notes.title: Demo Update v0.53
notes.notes:
Thank you to everyone who joined the playtest during the Next Fest October 2024 and provided valuable feedback!

In this small patch, we've implemented a few small fixes and optimizations to the demo:

[olist]
[*] Improved Hint Display: In-game hints are now clearer, helping players quickly understand the current battle situation.
[*] Crystal Value Fix: Fixed an issue where the crystal value color displayed incorrectly after using a magic card to restore crystals.
[*] Sound Volume Adjustment: Adjusted the sound volume balance.
[*] Updated  New Lightning Attack Sound: Updated the sound effect for lightning attacks.
[*] Added Mouse Lock Cursor Setting: A new toggle for locking the cursor has been added to the settings menu.
[/olist]

Additionally, based on the valuable feedback received during the festival, we're working on developing new content, which will be added to the demo in future updates. 
Stay tuned for details and updates, more information soon!
